race.title: Boyle Sports Back Yourself Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: THE KALOOKI KID didn't go on from his return last season, but he reverts to hurdles from 11 lb below his chase mark and has had a breathing operation ahead of his reappearance. Representing a stable amongst the winners, he gets the vote ahead of Jericoacoara , who opened his account for his current yard when last seen in May. THE KALOOKI KID JERICOACOARA (FR) NOPRESENTLIKETIME (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Jericoacoara (10/11), Who's Going (4/1), Nopresentliketime (9/2), The Kalooki Kid (7/1), Shantwopointfive (20/1), Fine Thing (20/1)
